article.story: SPARTANBURG, S.C. -- — Jackson Sivills scored 19 points as Wofford beat The Citadel 79-68 on Wednesday night. Sivills also contributed five rebounds for the Terriers (11-9, 5-2 Southern Conference). Kyler Filewich scored 12 points and added five rebounds. Justin Bailey had 12 points and went 5 of 7 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range). Brody Fox finished with 18 points and two steals for the Bulldogs (5-13, 0-7). Cameron Glover added 17 points and Paxton Davidson finished with 16 points. The loss was the Bulldogs' 10th in a row. Both teams play Saturday. Wofford visits Samford and The Citadel plays Western Carolina at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
